svg.title: millpond: captures in, items out
svg.desc: Three adapters, headwater for releases, eddy for meetings and a folder drop for files, each print one capture line on their tick. millpond lands each capture once by its key and banks its raw file on the host, outside git. A second tick prints the same release, and millpond passes it over because the key is already held. The release is its own excerpt and becomes one signal; a reader turns the meeting into three signals and the file into two. A curation session proposes a move for each of the six signals; the operator accepts and one commit writes them all: two drops, one answered, and three joined into one item, bump mise. millpond sends the item to one worktree, an agent works from its brief and submits, sluice lands the merge on main, and millpond records the landing on the item.
svg.text: the inbox: what happened in, work out
MILLPOND · THE INBOX, A GIT REPOSITORY
RAW BANK · ON THIS HOST, NEVER IN GIT
releases of what a repo pins
any file in a watched folder
a deployer, a script, a person:
BATCH · A SESSION PROPOSES A MOVE FOR EACH
YOU ACCEPT · ONE COMMIT WRITES THEM ALL

g.text: worktree · an agent with the brief
Each event lands once, by key;
One item goes to one worktree,
